title: An Embarrassingly Simple Detector for Model Extraction Attacks in Large Language Model API Traffic
abstract: arXiv:2606.05725v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed through hosted APIs, making model extraction a practical threat to model ownership and service security. Individual extraction queries often resemble benign requests, while existing evaluations often focus on single-query anomaly scoring or pure benign-versus-attacker user settings. We formulate model extraction monitoring as benign-calibrated traffic-window distribution testing: embed incoming queries into a semantic space and test whether their aggregate distribution deviates from historical benign traffic. We instantiate this formulation with maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), using only benign-vs-benign comparisons to set the decision threshold. We evaluate on fourteen attacker-normal query pairs from four extraction scenarios and compare with adapted PRADA, SEAT, CAP, DATE, marginal Mahalanobis, and pseudo-class energy baselines. Across three random seeds, MMD achieves 0.

translated_title: 一种用于大型语言模型API流量中模型提取攻击的极其简单检测器
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地通过托管API部署，使得模型提取成为对模型所有权和服务安全的实际威胁。单个提取查询通常与良性请求相似，而现有评估往往集中于单查询异常评分或纯良性-攻击者用户设置。我们将模型提取监控表述为良性校准的流量窗口分布测试：将传入查询嵌入语义空间，并测试其聚合分布是否偏离历史良性流量。我们使用最大均值差异（MMD）实例化此表述，仅使用良性-良性比较来设置决策阈值。我们在四种提取场景的十四个攻击者-正常查询对上进行评估，并与改编的PRADA、SEAT、CAP、DATE、边际马氏距离和伪类能量基线进行比较。在三个随机种子下，MMD实现了0.0的假阳性率，同时有效检测所有攻击者，且检测延迟低于现有方法。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于最大均值差异（MMD）的简单检测器，通过比较API流量窗口的语义分布与历史良性流量，有效且低延迟地检测模型提取攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simple detector based on maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) that effectively and efficiently detects model extraction attacks by comparing semantic distributions of API traffic windows against historical benign traffic.
